title: Zephyr: link-local address assignment
description: Acceptance: assigns fe80:: link-local to client
notes: Verified the spec-selected static LCI profile (node fe80::1, client fe80::2). Hardened Zephyr SLIP interface initialization so missing device context, address-add failure, and interface-up failure remain non-ready and propagate through init; rejected pre-init interface TX before mutex setup. Added exact fe80::1/manual/IID/interface-up/readiness assertions. Validation: Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 focused build and run passed 20/20 tests using the existing UART overlay; -Wduplicated-branches was demoted only for a Zephyr logging-macro false positive. git diff --check passed.
close_reason: Implemented and verified deterministic Zephyr LCI link-local interface assignment and readiness/error handling; focused QEMU suite passes 20/20.
